title: Roles of an OS, Batch, Time-Sharing and Real-Time Systems
description: Resource manager, control program, batch systems, multiprogramming, time-sharing, and hard/soft real-time constraints.
subtopics: OS as resource manager & abstract machine
Hard vs soft real-time operating systems

title: User Mode, Kernel Mode and System Call Execution
description: Hardware protection, dual-mode operation (mode bit), trap instructions, and system call invocation sequence.
subtopics: Privileged instructions and hardware mode bit
Software interrupts and system call traps

title: Process States, Process Control Block (PCB) and Context Switching
description: Process memory layout (text, data, heap, stack), 5-state process lifecycle, PCB contents, and context switch overhead.
subtopics: Process lifecycle (New, Ready, Running, Waiting, Terminated)
Context switch mechanics and hardware latency

title: Ready Queue, CPU Schedulers and Preemption vs Non-Preemption
description: Scheduling queues (job, ready, device), short/medium/long-term schedulers, and preemptive vs non-preemptive policies.
subtopics: Ready queue and I/O waiting queues

title: FCFS, SJF, SRTF, Priority and Round Robin
description: Scheduling performance criteria (CPU utilization, throughput, turnaround, waiting, response time), algorithms, and Gantt charts.
subtopics: Shortest Job First (SJF) and Shortest Remaining Time First (SRTF)
Round Robin (RR) and time quantum sizing

title: Threads vs Processes, User-Level and Kernel-Level Threads
description: Lightweight processes, shared address space, thread control blocks, user-level vs kernel-level threads, and multithreading models.
subtopics: Threads vs processes (shared memory vs isolated)

title: Shared Memory, Message Passing, Pipes and Sockets
description: Mechanisms for cooperating processes: shared memory segments, message queues, anonymous/named pipes, and network sockets.
subtopics: Shared memory vs Message passing tradeoffs

title: Critical Section Problem, Race Conditions and Mutual Exclusion
description: Race conditions, critical section criteria (mutual exclusion, progress, bounded waiting), and Peterson's algorithm.
subtopics: Peterson's software solution for two processes

title: Counting Semaphores, Binary Semaphores and Mutex Locks
description: Hardware atomic instructions (TestAndSet, CompareAndSwap), mutex locks, wait() / signal() operations on counting semaphores.

title: Producer-Consumer, Dining Philosophers and Readers-Writers
description: Classical synchronization benchmarks: bounded buffer producer-consumer, readers-writers priority, and dining philosophers deadlock.

title: Coffman Conditions, Prevention and Deadlock Avoidance
description: Four necessary Coffman conditions for deadlock, deadlock prevention strategies, and resource allocation graphs.
subtopics: Mutual exclusion, Hold & Wait, No Preemption, Circular Wait

title: Resource Allocation Graphs, Banker's Algorithm and Recovery
description: Deadlock avoidance: safe states, Dijkstra's Banker's algorithm (Allocation, Max, Available, Need matrices), and recovery actions.

title: Logical vs Physical Address Space, Contiguous Allocation and Swapping
description: MMU address translation, base and limit registers, contiguous allocation (First-Fit, Best-Fit, Worst-Fit), and fragmentation.

title: Paging Architecture, Page Tables, TLB and Segmentation
description: Fixed-size frames and pages, page table lookup, Translation Lookaside Buffer (TLB) hit ratios, and segmentation.
subtopics: Pages, frames, and page offset calculations
Page table base register and lookup cost

title: Demand Paging, Page Faults, FIFO, LRU and Optimal Algorithms
description: Demand paging, page fault handling service cycle, Belady's anomaly, FIFO, LRU, Optimal (OPT), and thrashing.
subtopics: Belady's anomaly on FIFO and Thrashing

title: File Allocation Methods, Directory Structures and FCFS, SSTF, SCAN, C-SCAN
description: File system implementation: inodes, contiguous/linked/indexed allocation, and disk arm scheduling algorithms.
subtopics: UNIX inode structure and indirect blocks
Contiguous, linked, and indexed file allocation
Disk scheduling: FCFS, SSTF, SCAN (Elevator), C-SCAN
